title: Material badge anchor corners
purpose: Check all four logical badge corners and how start and end mirror in RTL.
changes: Added top-start, top-end, bottom-start and bottom-end badge placement while retaining the existing default.
steps: Under Badge anchor corner, the label starts at Top end and the 3 badge should sit at the top right of the inbox icon.
Tap Change badge corner repeatedly. Check Bottom end, Bottom start and Top start place the badge at the corresponding corners; the icon should remain still.

Turn on Right-to-left layout and repeat. Start and end should swap left/right while top and bottom remain unchanged. Choose OK if it works, or Reject with the failing step, what you saw and your device.
expected: All four logical corners work and mirror horizontally in RTL without moving the icon.
limits: This uses Bhoo's current badge offsets and dimensions. Android custom insets, exact theme tokens and device visual parity remain unverified.
validation: Rust checks verify all four positions in LTR and RTL and unchanged owner bounds.
Full libbhoo Rust test suite passed.
A 320 × 500 browser test verified corner selection and RTL interaction.
